description: This Java source file defines the class ComcastPollControlCheckinEvent, which extends ClusterCommandEvent. It constructs a specific Zigbee event with payload data including battery voltage, temperature, RSSI, LQI, retries, and rejoins, and provides methods to generate the command payload and retrieve RSSI and LQI values.
